proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.targetRestriction
proposed_widenings.justification: Water Walk normally targets up to 10 creatures, but the ring restricts casting to the wearer only. The current grant_spell_access atom has no field to express this target restriction. Without it, the encoded trace implies unconstrained targeting, which misrepresents the item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this ring, you cast Water Walk from it, targeting only yourself.

notes: Typecheck passes and tracer runs clean. The passive + grant_spell_access(at_will, water_walk) encoding honestly represents the core mechanic (at-will Water Walk from the ring). The single gap is that grant_spell_access has no targetRestriction field, so the 'self-only' constraint cannot be expressed. This pattern recurs across many SRD magic items whose rings/wands grant spells with restricted targeting (e.g., Rings that cast concentration spells on self only). A targetRestriction variant on grant_spell_access (e.g., { kind: 'self_only' }) would close the gap across the family.
